# Netflix4U

> Netflix4U is an ultra-fast entertainment discovery and streaming web application delivering verified catalog information for global movies, web series, anime, K-dramas, Bollywood, Hollywood, South Indian cinema, and Hindi-dubbed releases.

## Core Navigation

- [Netflix4U Home](https://netflix4u.in/): Primary catalog discovery and featured streaming releases.
- [Movies](https://netflix4u.in/movies): Comprehensive library of feature films across all genres and release years.
- [Web Series](https://netflix4u.in/series): Multi-season television shows and exclusive web series.
- [Trending](https://netflix4u.in/trending): Real-time trending movies, series, and top daily streams.
- [Anime](https://netflix4u.in/anime): Japanese animation with multi-audio dubbed and subtitled options.
- [K-Drama](https://netflix4u.in/kdrama): Korean television dramas and romantic series.
- [Bollywood](https://netflix4u.in/bollywood): Hindi cinema, musical blockbusters, and new releases.
- [Hollywood](https://netflix4u.in/hollywood): International box-office titles and franchises.
- [South Indian Cinema](https://netflix4u.in/south-indian): Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam, and Kannada films.
- [Hindi Dubbed](https://netflix4u.in/hindi-dubbed): Dual-audio and regional dubbed releases.

## Information & Policies

- [About Us](https://netflix4u.in/about): Platform overview, architecture, and mission.
- [Privacy Policy](https://netflix4u.in/privacy): User privacy protection, cookie policy, and data handling standards.
- [Terms of Service](https://netflix4u.in/terms): Platform usage terms and user guidelines.
- [DMCA Disclaimer](https://netflix4u.in/dmca): DMCA copyright compliance, takedown policy, and notice procedure.
- [Contact Support](https://netflix4u.in/contact): Official support and communication channels.

## Optional Resources

- [Sitemap](https://netflix4u.in/sitemap.xml): Complete machine-readable XML index of catalog media pages.
- [Web Application Manifest](https://netflix4u.in/manifest.json): Progressive Web App configuration and install metadata.
